items.Sentence: WDRs Order No. 5-01-257 authorizes a discharge of 3.5 million gallons per day (mgd) of wastewater to percolation ponds (Ponds 1 through 7) with a surface area of approximately 39 acres.

The construction of the expanded WWTF was completed in November 2009. The expanded WWTF includes a headworks, two oxidation ditches, one anoxic basin, four secondary clarifiers, three return sludge holding tanks, and three centrifuges.

Historically sludge handling practices included discharging sludge to unlined sludge drying beds; a practice that was conducted for over twenty years and has impacted shallow groundwater.
The WWTF has approximately 1.5 acres of asphalt lined sludge drying beds that are only used in case of emergency.
Sludge generated at the WWTF will continue to be hauled off-site and discharged to McCarthy Family Farms Inc., near Corcoran, California, for composting under appropriate WDRs.
